prompt: Create a polished anime-style vertical portrait of a young female tactical officer in a ruined concrete military shelter, shown from mid-thigh up and turned three-quarters away while looking back over her shoulder with a gentle, confident smile. She has light ash-brown short bobbed hair with soft bangs and flyaway strands, large pink eyes, fair skin, and a subtle blush. Her outfit is an elegant black military coat with gold trim, brass buttons, a high collar, decorative shoulder cords, an eagle-like gold insignia on the sleeve, a fitted tactical belt with pouches, black gloves, a short skirt edge visible under the coat, thigh straps, and black thigh-high stockings. She holds one modern black assault rifle diagonally across her body with both hands, detailed with a scope, rail system, magazine, suppressor-like barrel attachment, and realistic mechanical parts. The scene is set in a war-torn concrete bunker with sandbags and stacked equipment crates, with cracked walls, a dark ceiling, dusty air, and rubble in the background. Warm sunlight streams dramatically from the upper right in visible beams, creating glowing dust particles, rim light on her hair and coat, soft lens bloom, and high-contrast cinematic shadows. Use highly detailed Japanese anime illustration quality, delicate linework, semi-realistic lighting, rich fabric folds, metallic weapon details, dynamic coat movement sweeping left, shallow depth of field, and a warm sepia-gray color palette. No text, no watermark, no extra characters, exactly one girl and exactly one rifle.

promptZh: 创作一张精致的动漫风格竖版肖像，描绘一名身处废弃混凝土军事掩体中的年轻女战术军官。画面采用大腿以上的中景构图，她身体侧转四分之三，回眸望向镜头，带着温柔而自信的微笑。她留着 浅灰棕色 的短波波头，配有柔和的刘海和几缕发丝，拥有一双硕大的 粉色 眼眸、白皙的皮肤和淡淡的红晕。她身穿一件优雅的黑色军装大衣，配有金色饰边、黄铜纽扣、高领设计、装饰性肩章绳、袖口上的鹰形金色徽章，以及带有战术包的贴身战术腰带；内搭短裙边缘隐约可见，腿部配有腿带和黑色过膝袜。她双手斜持一把现代黑色突击步枪，步枪细节丰富，配有瞄准镜、导轨系统、弹匣、消音器式枪管附件及逼真的机械结构。场景设定在 一个饱受战争蹂躏、堆满沙袋和装备箱的混凝土掩体 中，背景可见开裂的墙壁、阴暗的天花板、尘土飞扬的空气和瓦砾。温暖的阳光从右上角倾泻而下，形成明显的丁达尔效应，营造出闪烁的尘埃粒子、发丝与大衣边缘的轮廓光、柔和的镜头光晕以及高对比度的电影感阴影。采用高细节的日式动漫插画质量，线条细腻，光影半写实，衣物褶皱丰富，武器金属质感逼真，大衣呈现向左飘动的动态感，景深较浅，整体色调为温暖的深褐色与灰色。画面中无文字、无水印、无多余角色，仅限一名少女和一把步枪。
